```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R", "load_data.R"))
source(here::here("R", "export_dwc.R"))
source(here::here("R", "export_dashboard_json.R"))
source(here::here("R", "load_helper.R"))

load_helper()
data_objects <- load_data()
dwc_objects <- export_dwc(data_objects)

list2env(data_objects, envir = knitr::knit_global())
list2env(dwc_objects, envir = knitr::knit_global())
```

## Export DWC

### Export event and occurrence tables

```{r export-dwc-csv}
dwc_csv_files <- export_dwc_csv(dwc_objects)

tibble::tibble(
  output = names(dwc_csv_files),
  file = unname(dwc_csv_files)
) |>
  show_table(
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      "Darwin Core CSV files written by the workflow."
    )
  )
```

```{r preview-events}
show_table(
  events |> head(),
  caption = htmltools::tags$caption("Preview of the Darwin Core event table.")
)
```

```{r preview-occurrences}
show_table(
  occurrences |> head(),
  caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
    "Preview of the Darwin Core occurrence table."
  )
)
```

### Export metadata

```{r export-dwc-eml}
dwc_eml_file <- export_dwc_eml(data_objects, dwc_objects)

tibble::tibble(
  output = "eml",
  file = dwc_eml_file
) |>
  show_table(
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption("Generated EML metadata file.")
  )
```

```{r metadata-summary}
metadata_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  field = c(
    "Publication date",
    "Temporal range",
    "Bounding box",
    "Combined surveys",
    "Combined taxa",
    "Combined observations",
    "Combined individuals"
  ),
  value = c(
    as.character(export_date),
    paste(dataset_summary$first_date, "to", dataset_summary$last_date),
    paste(
      "Lat",
      bounding_box$south,
      "to",
      bounding_box$north,
      "| Lon",
      bounding_box$west,
      "to",
      bounding_box$east
    ),
    dataset_summary$n_survey_combined,
    dataset_summary$n_taxon_combined,
    dataset_summary$n_observation_combined,
    scales::comma(dataset_summary$n_individual_combined)
  )
)

show_table(
  metadata_summary,
  caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
    "Fields refreshed in the generated EML metadata."
  )
)
```

## Export dashboard

```{r export-dashboard-json}
dashboard_files <- export_dashboard_json(dwc_objects)

tibble::tibble(
  output = names(dashboard_files),
  file = unname(dashboard_files)
) |>
  show_table(
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      "Dashboard JSON files written by the workflow."
    )
  )
```
